shots.title: Default slope session end to the single active session (#620)
shots.notes: session end now prefers an explicit flag, then SLOPE_SESSION_ID, then the single active session; multiple active sessions list themselves in the error instead of a bare flag demand.

shots.title: Enrich standup with sprint, branch, scorecard state, commits, and claims, and fix negative transcript durations (#619)
shots.notes: StandupContext (sprint + scorecard state, branch + commits since session start, transcript volume) gathered best-effort in the CLI and rendered by the core formatter; transcript durations now come from min/max valid timestamps instead of positional first/last.

shots.title: Ship a wrap-session skill covering session end, unpushed-work warning, and handoff summary across harness templates (#620)
shots.notes: wrap-session template installed by slope init for Claude Code and Pi: standup wrap, uncommitted/unpushed checks, sprint + dangling-execution state, session end, handoff summary. Generated CLAUDE.md lists it.

yardage_book_updates: Standup context lives in the CLI layer (gatherStandupContext) so the core generator stays store/git-free; extend context there, not in core.
The root dist must be rebuilt (pnpm build) before dogfooding CLI changes — racing a background build reruns old code silently.
course_management_notes: The codex plugin's skill set was left untouched; its session guidance flows through AGENTS.md rather than a skill file, so parity there is a separate decision.
